question: The physical place where a computer stores information is called __________. (RRB ALP Fitter (21/01/2019) Shift 1)
options: Modem
Hard disk
Wi-Fi
POP
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Hard disk

Explanation:
The physical place where a computer stores information permanently is called a hard disk. It is a non-volatile storage device that retains data even when power is off. Hard disks contain magnetic platters where data is written and read. A modem is a networking device, Wi-Fi is a wireless technology, and POP is an email protocol; these are not storage devices.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:
☛ Permanent storage device in a computer → Hard disk
☛ How is data stored on a hard disk? → Magnetically
☛ Hard disk capacity is measured in → Gigabytes or Terabytes
☛ Types of hard disk → Internal (HDD/SSD) and External
☛ Example of non-volatile memory → Hard disk
question_hi: वह भौतिक स्थान जहाँ एक कंप्यूटर जानकारी स्टोर करता है, __________ कहलाता है। (RRB ALP Fitter (21/01/2019) Shift 1)

वाई - फाई
पॉप

question: ________ is the most common way of connecting computers on a network with wired connection.  (RRB ALP Fitter (21/01/2019) Shift 1)
options: LAN
Wi-Fi
Ethernet
Inernet
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Ethernet

Explanation:
Ethernet is the most common way of connecting computers on a network with wired connection. It is a wired networking technology used in LAN (Local Area Network). Ethernet uses RJ45 connectors and twisted pair cables. It is based on the IEEE 802.3 standard and uses the CSMA/CD protocol for data transfer. LAN is a network type, while Ethernet is a technology. Wi-Fi is wireless and the Internet is a global network, so they are not correct.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:
☛ What is the standard for Ethernet? → IEEE 802.3
☛ Which protocol is used in Ethernet? → CSMA/CD
☛ Types of Ethernet cables? → Twisted Pair, Coaxial, Fiber Optic
☛ In which network is Ethernet used? → LAN
☛ Which connector is used in Ethernet? → RJ45

question: A/An ______ is a special high-speed storage mechanism. (RRB ALP Fitter (21/01/2019) Shift 2)
options: interface
board
cache
host
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is cache

Explanation:
A cache is a high-speed storage mechanism that sits between the processor and main memory, used to speed up data access. It temporarily stores frequently used data and instructions, reducing the time the processor takes to retrieve data. Cache memory is typically made of SRAM (Static Random Access Memory), which is faster than DRAM. There are three main levels of cache: L1, L2, and L3. L1 cache is the fastest and smallest, while L3 cache is slower but larger. Cache memory plays a crucial role in improving processor performance by minimizing the latency of memory access.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:
☛ Which type of memory is the fastest? → Cache memory
☛ What type of memory is cache memory? → SRAM
☛ Where is L2 cache located? → Inside the processor or on the motherboard
☛ What is the function of cache? → To speed up data access
☛ Which is the smallest cache level? → L1 cache
question_hi: ______ एक विशेष उच्च गति भंडारण तंत्र है। (RRB ALP Fitter (21/01/2019) Shift 2)

बोर्ड
कैशे

Explanation:
कैशे एक उच्च गति वाला भंडारण तंत्र है जो कंप्यूटर के प्रोसेसर और मुख्य मेमोरी के बीच डेटा एक्सेस की गति बढ़ाने के लिए उपयोग किया जाता है। यह अस्थायी रूप से बार-बार उपयोग होने वाले डेटा और निर्देशों को संग्रहीत करता है, जिससे प्रोसेसर को डेटा प्राप्त करने में लगने वाला समय कम हो जाता है। कैशे मेमोरी सामान्यतः SRAM (स्टैटिक रैंडम एक्सेस मेमोरी) से बनी होती है, जो DRAM से तेज होती है। कैशे के तीन मुख्य स्तर होते हैं: L1, L2 और L3 कैशे। L1 कैशे सबसे तेज और सबसे छोटा होता है, जबकि L3 कैशे धीमा लेकिन बड़ा होता है। कैशे मेमोरी प्रोसेसर की कार्यक्षमता को बढ़ाने में महत्वपूर्ण भूमिका निभाती है।

☛ कैशे मेमोरी किस प्रकार की मेमोरी है? → SRAM
☛ L2 कैशे कहाँ स्थित होता है? → प्रोसेसर के अंदर या मदरबोर्ड पर

question: A/An ______ is software used to maintain the security of a private network. (RRB ALP Fitter (23/01/2019) Shift 1)
options: malware
encryption
firewall
clickbait
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is firewall

Explanation:
A firewall is a security software or hardware that protects a private network from unauthorized access. It controls incoming and outgoing traffic and blocks malicious data. The network security firewall acts as a barrier between internal and external threats. It uses techniques like packet filtering, stateful inspection, and application-layer gateways based on rules. Malware, encryption, and clickbait, unlike firewall, serve different purposes for network security. Firewalls are essential in today's cyber threat landscape.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:
☛ What is the main function of a firewall? → To filter and control network traffic
☛ At which layer does packet filtering work? → Network layer (OSI model)
☛ What does a stateful firewall track? → The state of active connections
☛ At which layer does an application-layer firewall operate? → Application layer of OSI model
☛ Which software performs the opposite function of a firewall? → VPN (for encryption and tunneling)
question_hi: ______ एक सॉफ्टवेयर है जिसका उपयोग निजी नेटवर्क की सुरक्षा बनाए रखने के लिए किया जाता है। (RRB ALP Fitter (23/01/2019) Shift 1)

question: A software program that has been developed to harm other computers is called a/an _________. (RRB ALP Fitter (23/01/2019) Shift 3)
options: server
LAN
malware
operating system
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is malware

Explanation:
Malware is a software program specifically designed to damage computer systems, steal data, or gain unauthorized access. It is short for 'Malicious Software'. Common types of malware include viruses, worms, Trojan horses, ransomware, spyware, and adware. These programs infiltrate systems without user consent, potentially destroying files, stealing sensitive information, or rendering the system unusable. Protection against malware requires antivirus software, firewalls, and regular updates. Among the given options, server, LAN, and operating system are not harmful software but useful systems. Malware is a significant cybersecurity threat, and understanding its types is crucial for competitive exams.

☛ Which malware self-replicates? → Worm
☛ Which malware encrypts data for ransom? → Ransomware
☛ Which malware secretly steals information? → Spyware
☛ What is the process of removing a virus from an infected file? → Disinfection
question_hi: एक सॉफ्टवेयर प्रोग्राम जिसे अन्य कंप्यूटरों को नुकसान पहुंचाने के लिए विकसित किया गया है, उसे _________ कहा जाता है। (RRB ALP Fitter (23/01/2019) Shift 3)

LAN
मालवेयर
ऑपरेटिंग सिस्टम
solution_hi:
Solution: सही उत्तर है मालवेयर

Explanation:
मालवेयर (Malware) एक सॉफ्टवेयर प्रोग्राम है जिसे कंप्यूटर सिस्टम को नुकसान पहुंचाने, डेटा चुराने या अनधिकृत पहुंच प्राप्त करने के लिए डिज़ाइन किया गया है। यह 'Malicious Software' का संक्षिप्त रूप है। मालवेयर के विभिन्न प्रकार हैं: वायरस (Virus), वर्म (Worm), ट्रोजन हॉर्स (Trojan Horse), रैनसमवेयर (Ransomware), स्पाइवेयर (Spyware) और एडवेयर (Adware)। ये प्रोग्राम उपयोगकर्ता की सहमति के बिना सिस्टम में प्रवेश करते हैं और फाइलों को नष्ट कर सकते हैं, संवेदनशील जानकारी चुरा सकते हैं, या सिस्टम को अनुपयोगी बना सकते हैं। मालवेयर से बचाव के लिए एंटी-वायरस सॉफ्टवेयर, फ़ायरवॉल और नियमित अपडेट आवश्यक हैं। विकल्पों में सर्वर, LAN और ऑपरेटिंग सिस्टम हानिकारक सॉफ्टवेयर नहीं हैं, बल्कि उपयोगी प्रणालियाँ हैं।

question: JPEG stands for __________. (RRB ALP Fitter (23/01/2019) Shift 3)

question: What is full form of SMPS? (RRB ALP Electrician (23/01/2019) Shift 2)
options: Switch Mode Power Supply
Simple Mode Power Supply
Storage Mode Power Supply
Storage Mode Power Shortage
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Switch Mode Power Supply

Explanation:
The full form of SMPS is Switch Mode Power Supply. It is an electronic device that efficiently converts electrical power using switching transistors to regulate voltage. SMPS operates by rapidly switching the input power on and off, reducing energy loss compared to linear power supplies. This results in higher efficiency (typically 80-90%) and a smaller form factor. SMPS is widely used in devices like computers, mobile chargers, TVs, and other electronics due to its compact size and heat efficiency. It plays a crucial role in modern electronics by providing stable and efficient power conversion.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:
☛ Full form of SMPS → Switch Mode Power Supply
☛ Switching device used in SMPS → Transistor or MOSFET
☛ Efficiency of SMPS → 80-90%
☛ Applications of SMPS → Computers, chargers, TVs
☛ Less efficient than SMPS → Linear power supply

question: RAM is a _____  (RRB ALP Electronics Mechanic (23/01/2019) Shift 1)
options: type of software
CPU register
temporary memory device
permanent memory device.
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is temporary memory device

Explanation:
RAM (Random Access Memory) is a temporary memory device, also known as volatile memory. This means that when the computer is turned off, the data stored in it is lost. RAM is used to store data and instructions that the processor needs to access quickly. It acts as a buffer between the CPU and storage devices, improving system speed. There are two main types of RAM: DRAM (Dynamic RAM) and SRAM (Static RAM). DRAM is used as main memory, while SRAM is used for cache memory.

question: The computer system which does not require any storage device?A. AnalogB. DigitalC. HybridD. Third generation computer (RRB NTPC Tier I (27/04/2016) Shift 1)
options: B
A
C
D
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Analog

Explanation:
Analog computers do not require any storage device because they work by measuring continuous physical quantities like voltage, pressure, or temperature. They process data directly through physical measurements and do not need to store data digitally. Digital computers store data in binary form and require storage devices. Hybrid computers combine both analog and digital components. Third generation computers use integrated circuits and require storage devices. Analog computers are mainly used in scientific and engineering applications where real-time measurement is needed.

question: Name the device used to connect computers for communication via telephone lines.A. HUBB. SwitchC. RepeaterD. MODEM (RRB NTPC Tier I (27/04/2016) Shift 3)
options: D
A
C
B
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is MODEM

Explanation:
The device used to connect computers for communication via telephone lines is the MODEM (Modulator-Demodulator). It converts digital signals from a computer into analog signals for transmission over telephone lines and vice versa. HUB and Switch connect devices within a Local Area Network (LAN), while a Repeater regenerates weakened signals. Therefore, for telephone line communication, a MODEM is essential to enable data transfer over the analog telephone network.

question: In MS Excel, what is function inside another function called?A. Round FunctionB. Sandwich functionC. Switch functionD. Nested function  (RRB NTPC Tier I (28/04/2016) Shift 2)
options: C
B
D
A
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Nested Function

Explanation:
In MS Excel, using one function inside another is called a nested function. This is useful when the output of one function becomes the input for another. For example, =IF(A1>10, SUM(B1:B5), AVERAGE(C1:C5)) contains SUM and AVERAGE as nested functions. Excel allows up to 64 levels of nesting. Nested functions simplify complex calculations but must be used carefully to avoid errors. They are commonly used in data analysis, financial modeling, and conditional calculations.
